Rain13K: Composite Single-Image Deraining Training Benchmark (Unofficial Mirror)
	


  









Unofficial redistribution of Rain13K, the composite single-image deraining training set (aggregating Rain800, Rain100H, Rain100L, Rain14000, and Rain12) used as the standard training data by MPRNet, Restormer, and most subsequent SOTA deraining papers, packaged for direct use with ClearView's dataset pipeline.
